title: Polish the Q3 operations brief
instruction:
# Polish the Q3 operations brief

LibreOffice Writer is open with `Quarterly_Brief_Source.fodt`. Using only the graphical desktop application, create a polished copy with these changes:

- Replace the first-line title with exactly `Q3 Operations Brief`.
- Apply the built-in **Heading 1** paragraph style to that title and center it.
- Apply the built-in **Heading 2** paragraph style to the `Highlights` heading.
- In the sentence beginning `Support`, make only the words `customer response time` bold.
- Preserve all other wording and paragraph order.

Use **Save As** to save the finished document as `/home/user/Desktop/Q3_Operations_Brief.fodt` in Flat XML ODF Text Document format. Do not overwrite or otherwise modify the source document. Your deliverable is the saved Writer document, not a text export or a renamed non-ODF file.
task_toml:
schema_version = "1.3"
artifacts = [{ source = "/home/user/Desktop/Q3_Operations_Brief.fodt" }]

[task]
name = "pilot/quarterly-brief-polish"
version = "1.0.0"
description = "Polish a quarterly operations brief in LibreOffice Writer and save a native copy."
keywords = ["desktop", "cua", "libreoffice", "writer", "odf", "document-formatting"]
[[task.authors]]
name = "OpenAI"

[metadata]
difficulty = "medium"
category = "desktop-cua"
tags = ["gui", "office", "document-editing"]

[agent]
timeout_sec = 600.0
user = "user"

[verifier]
timeout_sec = 120.0

[environment]
docker_image = "<base-image>"
network_mode = "no-network"
cpus = 2
memory_mb = 8192
storage_mb = 16384

[environment.healthcheck]
command = "test -f /run/harbor-authored/ready"
interval_sec = 2.0
timeout_sec = 5.0
retries = 60

[[environment.mcp_servers]]
name = "desktop"
transport = "stdio"
command = "/usr/bin/sudo"
args = ["-n", "/usr/local/libexec/harbor-osworld-mcp.py"]

 <office:body><office:text>
  <text:p text:style-name="Standard">Quarterly Update</text:p>
  <text:p text:style-name="Standard">Prepared for the Operations Leadership Team</text:p>
  <text:p text:style-name="Standard">Highlights</text:p>
  <text:p text:style-name="Standard">Revenue grew 8% quarter over quarter.</text:p>
  <text:p text:style-name="Standard">Support improved customer response time by 17%.</text:p>
  <text:p text:style-name="Standard">Fulfillment reduced late shipments to 2.4%.</text:p>
 </office:text></office:body>
</office:document>

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
export HOME=/home/user DISPLAY=:1 XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$(id -u)
: "${TASK_PUBLIC:?TASK_PUBLIC is required}"
cp "$TASK_PUBLIC/Quarterly_Brief_Source.fodt" /workspace/Quarterly_Brief_Source.fodt
chmod 0644 /workspace/Quarterly_Brief_Source.fodt
mkdir -p "$HOME/Desktop"
find "$HOME/Desktop" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '.~lock.*#' -delete
rm -f "$HOME/Desktop/Q3_Operations_Brief.fodt"
nohup libreoffice --writer --norestore --nodefault --nolockcheck /workspace/Quarterly_Brief_Source.fodt > /tmp/quarterly-brief-libreoffice.log 2>&1 &
ready=0
for _ in $(seq 1 120); do
  windows="$(wmctrl -lx 2>/dev/null || true)"
  if printf '%s\n' "$windows" | grep -Eiq 'libreoffice-writer|libreoffice\.libreoffice|Quarterly_Brief_Source'; then ready=1; break; fi
  sleep 1
done
if [ "$ready" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "LibreOffice Writer did not become ready within 120 seconds." >&2
  echo "Observed windows:" >&2; wmctrl -lx >&2 2>/dev/null || true
  echo "LibreOffice log:" >&2; sed -n '1,240p' /tmp/quarterly-brief-libreoffice.log >&2 2>/dev/null || true
  exit 1
fi

# Quarterly Brief Polish

The agent uses LibreOffice Writer through the desktop bridge to restyle a supplied operations brief, preserve its content, and save a new Flat XML ODF document. See [instruction.md](instruction.md) for the requested edits.

## Environment

The task uses the assigned digest-pinned SPARE desktop image without a custom build. It runs offline with 2 CPUs, 8192 MB RAM, 16384 MB storage, and a 600-second agent timeout. Setup copies the fixed source into `/workspace`, clears stale desktop output, opens Writer, and performs a bounded 120-second multi-signal window readiness check.

## Verifier

The deterministic verifier hard-gates source integrity and native Flat XML ODF parsing. It then awards equal credit for exact content/order, the centered Heading 1 title, the Heading 2 section label, and the bold phrase. Missing output and a no-op receive zero. Style inheritance is resolved. The repaired Oracle locates and replaces the original title through Writer's Find UI before styling it, avoiding a selection failure measured in the first admission run.

## Layout

```text
.
├── instruction.md
├── task.toml
├── environment/
│   ├── setup.sh
│   └── public/Quarterly_Brief_Source.fodt
├── solution/solve.sh
└── tests/{test.sh,verify_document.py,source_reference.fodt}
```

## Running

```bash
harbor run -p output/env_000 -a oracle -e <env>
harbor run -p output/env_000 -a terminus-2 -m <model> -e <env>
```

The local authoring sandbox does not provide the qualified desktop runtime, so Oracle, no-op, and fresh-instance replay are host admission checks.
